description: P32 (plan M6-M9 section 5.12): stone-studded bands for a giant's fists, sunk with the drowned bells. They fit a giant of stage 4 to 6: two low hooks, then a third blow that seizes a staggered foe in reach; a hammerfist for the heavy. Their length is the forearm and fist they cover (the sweep from the elbow to the knuckles).
